text: {"name":"rf_calib_required","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Checks the indexed RF entry and services an eligible pending per-path operation by updating its counters and queues and issuing the bus command.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v3":"rf_entry_index","v4":"rf_entry_table","v7":"path_entry","v8":"path_entry","v10":"path_state","v11":"remaining_count"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Per-path pending marker, cleared when the operation is serviced."},{"offset":32,"meaning":"Per-path state flag used to determine eligibility and whether to decrement the secondary counter."},{"offset":112,"meaning":"Entry gate; processing continues only when its value is 1."},{"offset":113,"meaning":"Queue identifier passed to ke_queue_front."},{"offset":115,"meaning":"Condition selecting which queue-front mode to use."},{"offset":121,"meaning":"Counter decremented when the operation is serviced."},{"offset":122,"meaning":"Secondary counter decremented when the per-path state flag is 1."}]}
